notes: The update prompt now matches your theme. It was painted with fixed teal and orange, so it sat there looking like a different app and never followed the theme at all. Every part of it — the card, the title, the patch notes, the progress bar and both buttons — is now drawn from the app’s own colours, so it matches whatever theme you are on and follows a live RGB palette as it cycles

Updates install on their own when you open the app. The update was being handed to the phone with a “wait until the app is closed” condition, and a phone that keeps SideCut warm never fires that — so the update could sit staged indefinitely and had to be tapped in from the prompt. A downloaded update now installs the moment the app is actually launched, so the next launch is on the new version without you doing anything

Still never a mystery refresh: this happens only on a real launch, never when you come back to the app from the background — that resume path is what used to look like the app refreshing itself at random and taking your song with it. And it happens at most once per update: if a bundle somehow fails to take over, the next launch notices, marks it failed, and never tries that one again (the Check for updates button can still install it by hand). If a song is playing when the install comes up, it still waits for the app to close rather than cutting the music
